name: 62549 · Mt Zion, IL
findings: ZIP 62549 (Mt Zion) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (72%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62549 (Mt Zion) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62549 (Mt Zion) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
